overall_notes: The extraction was generally good but had some minor issues: incorrect assumption about human evaluation, incomplete dataset listing, and inconsistent model name formatting. The paper focuses on KG-to-Text generation with automated evaluation using both reference-based and reference-less metrics. No human evaluation or LLM-as-judge methods are used.
